title: Player Info Mod
description: With this mod you can view a players information.
body:
## Player Info!!!
Player Info is a mod that shows the information of a player that you have seen before. Can be a actual friend or just a player in the server. As long as you have came across the player once you will be able to see the players info.

This mod makes sure you see all info of the people you have seen in a server before so for example Bob joins the server and he leaves again after 5 minutes. If you type /playerinfo Bob in 15 minutes it will show all the info and for first seen it will say 20m ago and for last seen it will say 15m ago. For known names it will show all the known names you have seen that player use before so not names he has used before but you havent seen him use it or you have not had the mod on at that time. Name and uuid speaks for itself, name is the current name the player uses and uuid is the uuid of the player.

**This mod ONLY supports 1.21.11 as of now.**

The following info you see when you type the command:
- Name
- UUID
- First Seen
- Last Seen
- Known Names

Commands:
- /playerinfo <USERNAME> - to see all information of a player.
